data.long_meaning: The name Kayla is derived from the Hebrew name 'Kallah', which means 'maiden, bride, or bridegroom'. It was also used as a masculine name in ancient Greece and Latin. In Hebrew tradition, the name is derived from 'kal', meaning 'crown' or 'laurel', and 'el' meaning 'God'. So Kayla could be interpreted as 'crown of God' or 'laurel of God'. In the Bible, the name is associated with the beautiful and faithful wife of Hosea, as well as a village where King Saul gathered his army. Kayla represents the strength and faith of the women in these biblical stories and is a popular choice for Christian girls today.

in_greek.name: Καΐλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Καΐλα (Kayla) - ονόμα από την Αμερικανική-Εβραϊκή-Αγγλική-Αμερικανική. Καΐλα (Καΐλα) - θηλυκό του ονόματος Καΐλος. καλός, καλή, αρετή, ευγενεια, θάρρος.
